cond_0001.intro: The Reliability Engineering position supporting Asset Management will also assist with and coordinate all work needed to program and commission electronic devices installed on the distribution system. Duties include working with and around low voltage. Similar to the Area Reliability Engineer position, the successful candidates will work closely with area engineering, operating personnel, and Asset Management, providing them with technical expertise, breaker relay settings and protective device relay settings in support of Asset Management equipment replacements. This requires leading coordination across multiple work groups including P&C Applications, Operations Support, and P&C Field Services and/or Distribution Automation. The successful candidate must build rapport and establish strong professional relationships with peers and cross-functional teams across Power Delivery. Similar to the Area Reliability Engineer position, the successful candidate will work closely with area engineering, operating personnel, and Asset Management, sharing technical expertise, breaker relay settings, and protective device relay settings in support of Asset Management equipment replacements. This will require coordination with multiple work groups including P&C Applications, Operations Support, and P&C Field Services &/or Distribution Automation. To be effective, the successful candidate must be capable of communicating, building rapport, and establishing professional working relationships with peers and these cross-functional teams across Power Delivery. As with all Distribution Reliability Engineering positions, he or she will share responsibility for proper implementation of [Company name masked] reliability strategies and ensuring proper coordination of protective schemes. This position will also support other corporate reliability projects and initiatives as needed.
cond_0225.responsibilities:
Work alongside area engineering, operating personnel, and Asset Management to provide technical expertise, breaker relay settings, and protective device relay settings in support of equipment replacements.
Coordinate with P&C Applications, Operations Support, and P&C Field Services &/or Distribution Automation to support programming and commissioning of electronic devices on the distribution system.
Help ensure proper coordination of protective schemes and support implementation of reliability strategies.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Power Delivery to build and maintain effective working relationships.
Assist with corporate reliability projects and initiatives as needed.
Work with internal and external customers to articulate and support applicable company policies.
Support restoration efforts in-state and out-of-state, including overnight travel and statewide support.
Serve in the supervisor on-call rotation and be available for local area emergency assistance after hours, nights, weekends, and holidays.
cond_0225.requirements:

Knowledge of Section 0 and demonstrated Safety Excellence at all times.

Capable of producing designs that enhance system reliability performance.

Similar to the Area Reliability Engineer position, the successful candidates will work closely with area engineering, operating personnel, and Asset Management, providing them with technical expertise, breaker relay settings and protective device relay settings in support of Asset Management equipment replacements. cond_0277.intro: The Reliability Engineer supporting Asset Management will coordinate work needed to program and commission electronic devices installed on the distribution system. Duties include working with and around low voltage. The role provides technical expertise, breaker relay settings, and protective device relay settings in support of Asset Management equipment replacements. This requires coordination with multiple work groups including P&C Applications, Operations Support, and P&C Field Services and/or Distribution Automation. The successful candidate must be capable of communicating clearly and maintaining professional working relationships with peers and cross-functional teams across Power Delivery. This position is responsible for proper implementation of [Company name masked] reliability strategies and ensuring proper coordination of protective schemes, and will assist with other corporate reliability projects as needed.
cond_0277.responsibilities:
Coordinate all work needed to program and commission electronic devices on the distribution system.
Provide technical expertise, breaker relay settings, and protective device relay settings in support of Asset Management equipment replacements.
Interface with P&C Applications, Operations Support, and P&C Field Services and/or Distribution Automation as required by project tasks.
Ensure proper implementation of [Company name masked] reliability strategies and coordination of protective schemes.
Produce distribution designs that enhance system reliability performance.
Create quality distribution work orders, estimates, and construction prints.
Write and execute switching orders.
Communicate applicable company policies clearly to internal and external contacts.
Support other corporate reliability projects as assigned.
Serve in the supervisor on-call rotation at the assigned work location.
Provide local area emergency assistance after hours, nights, weekends, and holidays as required.
Support restoration efforts in-state and out-of-state as needed.
Travel overnight and provide statewide support, including driving to remote locations.

Similar to the Area Reliability Engineer position, the successful candidate will work closely with area engineering, operating personnel, and Asset Management, sharing technical expertise, breaker relay settings, and protective device relay settings in support of Asset Management equipment replacements. This will require coordination with multiple work groups including P&C Applications, Operations Support, and P&C Field Services &/or Distribution Automation. To be effective, the successful candidate must be capable of communicating, building rapport, and establishing professional working relationships with peers and these cross-functional teams across Power Delivery. As with all Distribution Reliability Engineering positions, he or she will share responsibility for proper implementation of [Company name masked] reliability strategies and ensuring proper coordination of protective schemes. This position will also support other corporate reliability projects and initiatives as needed.
cond_0297.responsibilities:
Work alongside area engineering, operating personnel, and Asset Management to provide technical expertise, breaker relay settings, and protective device relay settings in support of equipment replacements.
Coordinate with P&C Applications, Operations Support, and P&C Field Services &/or Distribution Automation to support programming and commissioning of electronic devices on the distribution system.
Help ensure proper coordination of protective schemes and support implementation of reliability strategies.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Power Delivery to build and maintain effective working relationships.
Assist with corporate reliability projects and initiatives as needed.
Work with internal and external customers to articulate and support applicable company policies.
Support restoration efforts in-state and out-of-state, including overnight travel and statewide support.
Serve in the supervisor on-call rotation and be available for local area emergency assistance after hours, nights, weekends, and holidays.
cond_0297.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor of Science in Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related field (e.g., Mathematics, Science); 4-year ABET accredited degree.
Minimum of 3 years operations experience in one or more of the following: Electric Power Distribution Operations, Electric Power Transmission Operations, Protection & Control (P&C) Field Services, P&C Applications.
Knowledge of Section 0 and demonstrated Safety Excellence at all times.
Knowledge of [Company name masked] distribution operating procedures.
Working knowledge of the NESC.
Proven experience writing and executing switching orders.
Capable of meeting the Official Transmission and Distribution Switching & Clearance List criteria.
Must hold a valid Driver's License.
Must have at least one year of verifiable driving experience (valid driver's license for the class vehicle to be operated; driving permits are not typically considered a valid driver's license). Must have no revocation of driving privileges within the 36 months prior to application, no convictions of major traffic violations (DUI, hit and run, reckless driving, etc.) within the 12 months prior to application, or any pending charges for a major traffic violation at the time of application. Must consent to continuous monitoring of your Motor Vehicle Record.
Capable of producing designs that enhance system reliability performance.
Capable of creating quality distribution work orders, estimates, and construction prints.
Effective project management and organizational skills.

Effective communication skills.

Similar to the Area Reliability Engineer position, the successful candidates will work closely with area engineering, operating personnel, and Asset Management, providing them with technical expertise, breaker relay settings and protective device relay settings in support of Asset Management equipment replacements. This will require interaction with multiple work groups including P&C Applications, Operations Support and P&C Field Services &/or Distribution Automation. To be effective, the successful candidate must be capable of communicating, building rapport, and establishing professional working relationships with all their peers and these cross-functional teams across Power Delivery. As with all Distribution Reliability Engineering positions, he or she will be responsible for proper implementation of [Company name masked] reliability strategies and ensuring proper coordination of protective schemes. This position will also assist with other corporate reliability projects and initiatives as needed.
cond_0318.requirements:
Education:
Bachelor of Science in Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a degree in a related field (i.e. Mathematics, Science); a 4-year ABET accredited degree is required, or equivalent practical experience. Engineer in Training (EIT) certification is a plus, or willingness to obtain. Professional Engineer (PE) license is preferred, or willingness to pursue.
Experience:
Around 3 years of operations experience in one or more of the following areas: Electric Power Distribution Operations, Electric Power Transmission Operations, Protection & Control (P&C) Field Services, P&C Applications. Relevant education or training may be considered alongside experience.
Driving:
This position requires use of a [Company name masked] fleet vehicle. The following apply:
At least one year of verifiable driving experience (must hold a valid driver's license for the class vehicle to be operated; driving permits are not typically considered a valid driver's license)
No revocation of driving privileges within the 36 months prior to application, no convictions of major traffic violations (DUI, hit and run, reckless driving, etc.) within the 12 months prior to application, or any pending charges for a major traffic violation at the time of application
Must consent to continuous monitoring of your Motor Vehicle Record

This requires leading coordination across multiple work groups including P&C Applications, Operations Support, and P&C Field Services and/or Distribution Automation. The successful candidate must build rapport and establish strong professional relationships with peers and cross-functional teams across Power Delivery. As with all Distribution Reliability Engineering positions, this role is accountable for proper implementation of [Company name masked] reliability strategies and ensuring proper coordination of protective schemes. This position will also take on other corporate reliability projects and initiatives as needed.
cond_0386.responsibilities:
Direct the programming and commissioning of electronic devices on the distribution system, including work with low voltage equipment.
Deliver technical expertise, breaker relay settings, and protective device relay settings to support Asset Management equipment replacements.
Lead coordination with P&C Applications, Operations Support, P&C Field Services, and Distribution Automation.
Build and maintain professional working relationships with peers and cross-functional teams across Power Delivery.
Ensure proper implementation of [Company name masked] reliability strategies and coordination of protective schemes.
Execute other corporate reliability projects and initiatives as assigned.

cond_0450.intro: The Reliability Engineering position supporting Asset Management will coordinate all work needed to program and commission electronic devices installed on the distribution system. Duties include working with and around low voltage. Similar to the Area Reliability Engineer position, the successful candidate will work closely with area engineering, operating personnel, and Asset Management, sharing technical expertise, breaker relay settings, and protective device relay settings in support of Asset Management equipment replacements. This will require coordination with multiple work groups including P&C Applications, Operations Support, and P&C Field Services and/or Distribution Automation. To be effective, the successful candidate must be capable of communicating, building rapport, and establishing professional working relationships with peers and these cross-functional teams across Power Delivery. As with all Distribution Reliability Engineering positions, this role carries shared responsibility for proper implementation of [Company name masked] reliability strategies and ensuring proper coordination of protective schemes. This position will also support other corporate reliability projects and initiatives as needed.

Similar to the Area Reliability Engineer position, the successful candidates will work closely with area engineering, operating personnel, and Asset Management, regularly providing them with technical expertise, breaker relay settings and protective device relay settings in support of Asset Management equipment replacements. cond_0602.intro: The Reliability Engineer supporting Asset Management will own all work needed to program and commission electronic devices installed on the distribution system, including work with and around low voltage. Like the Area Reliability Engineer role, this position works directly with area engineering, operating personnel, and Asset Management, delivering technical expertise, breaker relay settings, and protective device relay settings in support of equipment replacements. This requires leading coordination across multiple work groups including P&C Applications, Operations Support, and P&C Field Services and/or Distribution Automation. The successful candidate must build rapport and establish strong professional relationships with peers and cross-functional teams across Power Delivery. As with all Distribution Reliability Engineering positions, this role is accountable for proper implementation of [Company name masked] reliability strategies and ensuring proper coordination of protective schemes. This position will also take on other corporate reliability projects and initiatives as needed.
cond_0602.responsibilities:
Direct the programming and commissioning of electronic devices on the distribution system, including work with low voltage equipment.
Deliver technical expertise, breaker relay settings, and protective device relay settings to support Asset Management equipment replacements.
Lead coordination with P&C Applications, Operations Support, P&C Field Services, and Distribution Automation.
Build and maintain professional working relationships with peers and cross-functional teams across Power Delivery.
Ensure proper implementation of [Company name masked] reliability strategies and coordination of protective schemes.
Execute other corporate reliability projects and initiatives as assigned.
